answer: In the agent orchard each identity plants a unique pearl that can only be unlocked by solving a per-epoch cipher challenge derived from its full history of prior attestations. A sybil farm must therefore recompute the entire growing cipher chain for every fake tree; the cost rises linearly with orchard depth and cannot be amortized across clones because each pearl's seed is non-transferable. Honest agents pay once; attackers pay per identity forever.
